text:
amelia: Heads-up — PR #4231 for console/observability docs updated dashboard heatmap filters and the Go/Rust SDK snippets. CI flagged a snippet lint fail, and there's a broken tracing-hook link. Need a quick patch before Monday release. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4231

sam: Looking. Which snippet failed? paste the lint output?

amelia: docs-ci: snippet-lint error in docs/examples/console/heatmap.md line 42: invalid YAML block, unexpected indentation. Also the tracehook example uses old param name `trace_key` -> should be `trace_key_hex`. quick diff in PR.

jon: I saw that. The heatmap snippet has a code block like:
```yaml
- filters:
    - name: cost_bucket
      operator: in
      values: ["high"]
```
Indentation is off for the list item. Should be:
```yaml
filters:
  - name: cost_bucket
    operator: in
    values: ["high"]
```
I'll push a tiny fix.

maria: Also FYI the Go SDK sample uses the old function signature `Client.TraceHook(ctx, opts)` — needs the new method form `(*Client).TraceHook(ctx, params)`; examples repo compile check caught it. I'll send a patch for Go and mirror for Rust.

docs-ci: @jon docs-snippet-lint: re-run required after push. To re-run locally: `make docs-snippets-lint` or `npx snip-lint ./docs/examples/console/heatmap.md`.

ryan: @amelia @maria Do we need to add a changelog note? If snippets changed signature, call out breaking note under v2.1.

lila: Small QA note — saved query link in the heatmap preview still points to `/playground?utm=oldref`. Should be `/console/queries/<id>`. Found by qa/preview.

amelia: Action items: jon fixes yaml & trace param, maria updates Go+Rust snippets, lila fixes saved-query link. I'll re-run docs-ci once pushes are in and then request a docs ship. ETA EOD today?

jon: On it. Pushed yaml and trace param fixes in branch `amelia/docs-4231-fixes`. PR updated.

docs-ci: docs-snippet-lint passed ✅
tracing-hook-link-check failed: 404 at https://docs.redwood.ai/tracing/v1/old-examples.md

sam: I can either add a redirect on the site or update the doc. Prefer updating the doc to the canonical path `/tracing/hooks/overview.md`. Pushed link fix.

ryan: Added a short changelog blurb in the PR description about the TraceHook signature change and the heatmap query path update. Ready to merge after one more review.

maria: Go snippet updated; added note about the `TraceContext` field rename in the example. Rust snippet compile-checked and updated param name.

amelia: Thanks everyone — will merge after green checks. Will watch preview for any regressions. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Preview site build started for PR #4231 — logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/98765

deploy-bot: Preview deploy complete — preview URL https://deploy-preview-4231--docs.redwood.ai

sam: Verified preview — heatmap renders, saved-query link looks correct, tracehook link resolves, and SDK snippets compile in examples repo. All good from docs side, merging and closing thread.
